summary: Summit lookout on Roberts Mountain: a 1928 platform tower, a 60-foot L-6 cab tower built in 1933, and destroyed in 1958; no source describes the summit today.

facts.design: 60-foot pole tower with a 7 by 7 foot L-6 cab, after a 1928 platform tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1958; no source describes what remains on the summit

visit.trail_note: Hike-in; the climbing guide's route from the FST-407 trailhead is over 8 miles round trip

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says Kootenai National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts and Rex's page say Kaniksu. Kept Kaniksu, which the record already has and two sources give; the editor should confirm on a Forest Service map before final.

notes_for_editor: Forest name conflict is unresolved: firelookout.com says Kootenai, the other two Kaniksu; the record keeps Kaniksu. The approach starts in Troy, Montana, so check the coordinates on a map before any change. The 18.3 m height is the 60-foot tower; no source gives the cab-floor height. No source read gives a cause for the 1958 destruction. Sources do not say whether the summit is open to visitors.
